# Astro-Menu — Full Reference

## Overview

Astro-Menu (astro-menu.com) is a UAE-based, cloud-hosted QR digital menu and point-of-sale (POS) platform for food businesses. Restaurants, cafes, hotels, food trucks, drive-thrus, and social media food businesses use Astro-Menu to replace printed menus and expensive POS hardware with QR codes and a web dashboard.

How it works:
1. The restaurant builds a digital menu (meals, sections, prices, labels, translations) in the Astro-Menu dashboard.
2. Astro-Menu generates QR codes for each table, branch, or for sharing on social media.
3. Customers scan the QR code with their phone camera — no app download needed — and browse the menu, filter meals, and place orders directly.
4. Orders appear in real time on the cloud POS, waitstaff dashboard, and kitchen dashboard.
5. The restaurant tracks analytics: most-ordered meals, branch statistics, and order history.

## Key facts

- Cloud, web-based application. No software to install; works from any device with a browser.
- No commission on orders — flat monthly subscription fee.
- 14-day free trial. No credit card required to start.
- Includes its own cloud POS — does not integrate with third-party POS systems.
- Customers place orders via QR menu; payment processing is managed by the business, not by Astro-Menu.
- Pricing in AED (UAE).

## Features

Core:
- Instant QR menus — customers scan and order, no app download.
- Self-order — customers order from their phones without waiting for staff.
- Cloud POS — built-in point of sale, no annual contract or maintenance fees.
- Waitstaff dashboard — staff and chef accounts, order management, access URLs per device.
- Kitchen dashboard — order display for kitchen and drive-thru teams.
- Admin/CMS dashboard — manage meals, menus, branches, and translations.
- Multi-language menus with automatic translation (e.g. Arabic, and more).
- Meal labels — tag meals (decaf, sugar-free, gluten-free, and more).
- Analytics & reports — most-ordered meals, branch statistics, order history.
- Email and print receipts for orders.
- Google review links and social media links on the menu.
- WiFi password display.
- Multi-currency support.
- Real-time order updates.
- Responsive, modern design with minimal clicks.
- Call waiter feature.
- Social QR codes (shared via social media) and table-specific QR codes.

Highlights ("Why Astro-Menu"):
- No commissions — flat monthly fee, keep your profits.
- Cloud POS included — no annual contract, no maintenance fees.
- Instant QR menus — no app downloads, just scan & order.

## Use cases

- Restaurants
- Cafes and coffee shops
- Hotels and room service
- Food trucks
- Drive-thrus
- Hospitals and patient meal ordering
- Social media food businesses (home-based food brands)

## Pricing

All plans include a 14-day free trial (no credit card required) and unlimited menus, meals, and scans subject to a fair usage policy.

Essential — 149 AED/month (1490 AED/year):
- 1 QR code (menu viewing only)
- 1 translation language
- Unlimited meals, menus, and scans (fair usage policy)
- Social media links
- 1 branch

Advanced — 229 AED/month (2290 AED/year):
- 25 dine-in QR codes
- Drive-thru QR code
- Self-order
- Cloud POS
- 2 translation languages
- Unlimited meals, menus, scans (fair usage policy), and orders
- Analytics & reports
- Social media links
- 1 branch

Premium — 299 AED/month (2990 AED/year):
- 50 dine-in QR codes
- Drive-thru QR code
- Self-order
- Cloud POS
- 3 translation languages
- Premium support
- Unlimited meals, menus, scans (fair usage policy), and orders
- Analytics & reports
- Social media links
- 1 branch

Additional branches: contact hello@astro-menu.com.

## FAQ

Q: Can I try Astro-Menu before I buy?
A: Yes, you can try Astro-Menu for free for 14 days. Simply create an account and start using Astro-Menu right away.

Q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
A: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. Your subscription will be active until the end of the billing cycle.

Q: Does Astro-Menu integrate with POS systems?
A: No, Astro-Menu comes with its own cloud POS system. You can manage your orders and statistics directly from your Astro-Menu account.

Q: What is self-order?
A: Self-order allows customers to place orders directly from their phones without the need for a waiter(ess) to attend the table, allowing customers to order at their own pace and convenience, and improve the table turnover rate.

Q: Can customers pay directly from the menu?
A: No, Astro-Menu is a QR Menu that allows customers to view your menu and place orders. Payments are managed by you.

Q: How can I add more branches to my subscription?
A: Contact our sales team at hello@astro-menu.com and they will help you add more branches to your subscription.

Q: Do I need to install any software to use Astro-Menu?
A: Astro-Menu is a cloud web-based application. You don't need to install any software to use it. You can access it from any device with a web browser.
